local autocast_specials = require("projectiles.autocast_specials")
local autocast_dummy_attrs = require("projectiles.modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")

local DEBUG_CLONE = false

local function DebugClone(...)
    if DEBUG_CLONE then
        print(...)
    end

local function IsUnitBusy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility then
        local ab = unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility()
        if ab and not ab:IsNull() then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now)
    if not self or not self.projectiles then
        return false
    end
    local my_interval = profile and profile.interval or 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if other ~= profile then
            local other_interval = other.interval or 0
            if other_interval > my_interval then
                local ready = not other.next_cast_time or other.next_cast_time <= now
                if ready then
                    if (not other.is_attack and not other.skill) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif (not other.is_attack and other.skill and not other.skill:IsCooldownReady()) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif other.is_attack or other.behavior == "Target" or other.behavior == "Position" then
                        if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
                            ready = false
                        end
                        if not ready then
                            -- keep ready=false
                        else
                            local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
                            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(other.range)
                            local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
                                self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
                                origin,
                                nil,
                                range,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                                FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                false
                            )
                            if #enemies == 0 then
                                ready = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ready then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local default = {}
local hit_label = "projectile"

local function HasBehavior(behavior, flag)
    return behavior and string.find(behavior, flag, 1, true)
end

local function ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then
            return "Self"
        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function ParseAbilityDuration(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local dur = ability_kv.AbilityDuration
    if type(dur) == "number" then
        return dur
    end
    if type(dur) == "string" and dur ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(dur, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetAbilityCastRange(profile, pos, owner)
    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return 0
    end
    local ability = profile.skill
    local range = 0
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        range = ability:GetCastRange(pos or Vector(0, 0, 0), owner or ability:GetCaster())
    end
    if range and range > 0 then
        return range
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(profile.skill_kv or ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

local function ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not self or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return
    end
    if not self.special_handler or not self.special_handler.AfterCast then
        return
    end

    local handler = self.special_handler
    self.aftercast_timers = self.aftercast_timers or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        if not self or not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        handler:AfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
        return nil
    end)
    table.insert(self.aftercast_timers, id)
end

local function ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability)
    if not parent or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
    local behavior = ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE") then
        ability:ToggleAbility()
        return
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST") then
        if not ability:GetAutoCastState() then
            ability:ToggleAutoCast()
        end
        return
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end
end

local function GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

    }

                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()
        local enemy_pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        local dist = (enemy_pos - clone_pos):Length2D()
        local atk_range = clone:Script_GetAttackRange()
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack]", clone:GetUnitName(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "Distance", dist, "AtkRange",
            atk_range)
        local attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = clone:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, clone, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        if clone.RemoveGesture then
            clone:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
        end
        if clone.StartGesture then
            clone:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_ATTACK)
        end
        clone:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack] After", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "IsAttacking",
            clone.IsAttacking and clone:IsAttacking())
    else
        local ab = clone:FindAbilityByName(profile.projectile_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
            if ab then
                ab:SetLevel(1)
                ab:SetActivated(true)
            end
        end
        if not ab then
            return nil
        end


        if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Position = pos,
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local ttl = 0
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.GetSpecialValueFor then
            local dur = profile.skill:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
            if dur and dur > 0 then
                ttl = dur
            end
        end
        if ttl <= 0 then
            ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
        end
        self.clone_pause_until = math.max(self.clone_pause_until or 0, GameRules:GetGameTime() + ttl)
        self:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    end

    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()

        self:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)

    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then

    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)
    local use_clone = clone_available or profile.dummy_mode == "clone"

      if profile.behavior == "Self" then
